description: Painted facet projection and bridge contact geometry contracts. Only native assertion kills are executable acceptance cases.

mutants.description: an unpainted volume must leave the public output empty while painted facets still project
support projections intentionally ignore upward-facing facets while seam projections retain them
horizontal facets and one-slab projections must avoid interpolation and retain their analytic area
public projection output is indexed one-for-one with PrintObject layers
long bridge handling must not be selected for short perimeter bridges
the public break_bridge option controls whether an overlong perimeter bridge is segmented

known_survivors.description: vertical painted seams need the degeneracy guard; sloped facets must remain unchanged
